items.name: activity-bars
items.title: Activity Bars
items.description: A small equaliser whose bars rise and fall at different speeds while something plays, records or speaks, lie down when it stops and hold a still silhouette with reduced motion.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Confirmation dialog with confirm and cancel actions, a tone for the icon and the confirm button, an async onConfirm that shows failures inline, and an optional type-to-confirm phrase.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area Chart
items.description: Filled lines that overlap with a gradient, stack into a total or share a whole, with a crosshair, a tooltip and dashed comparison lines.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Avatar that falls back from a photo to initials to a person glyph, in five sizes, two shapes and six tones, with a presence dot, a button twin and an overlapping group with a +N counter.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small dot or count that caps at 99+, solid or soft in six tones, with a screen reader label and an anchor that pins it to the corner of an icon or avatar.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: Inline and top-of-page message in five tones, soft or on a raised surface, with a glyph per tone, actions, a dismiss button and a polite live region.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar Chart
items.description: Grouped, stacked and percent bars, vertical or horizontal, with capsule segments, a series below the baseline, full-height tracks, a ringed active column and a gliding tooltip.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Joins related buttons into one pill or spaces them apart, horizontal or vertical, and gives them a shared size, variant and tone.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Pill button in four variants, three tones and three sizes, with icons, a link twin and automatic pending state for async actions.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Container in four variants with header, media, content and footer parts, link and button cards, and selectable checkbox and radio cards.

items.name: chart-card
items.title: Chart Card
items.description: A card around one chart with a title, a rolling headline figure and a delta tag, a period switch, a table toggle, loading and empty states, and a readout mode that swaps the headline for the active bar.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: The parts every chart shares, from scales, ticks, stacking and curves to the colour roles, a legend, a tooltip card and the data table that gives each chart its accessible view.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox with an animated check, indeterminate state and descriptions, plus a group with validation and select-all.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Pill-shaped chips for filtering, choosing and entering values, in a keyboard-navigable group or on their own.

items.name: color-scheme
items.title: Colour scheme
items.description: Generates every colour role, including the layers and solid fills, plus success, warning and info from one seed colour at runtime.

items.name: combo-box
items.title: Combo box
items.description: Searchable select that ignores case and accents, matches keywords, loads results as you type and picks one or several options.

items.name: content-state
items.title: Content State
items.description: Switches between loading, error, empty and content for fetched data, with default copy, an async retry, a skeleton slot and a refresh-error banner.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Copies a string or an async value to the clipboard, morphs its icon into a check, announces the result and reports failures; icon-only or with a label.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Table driven by column definitions, with sorting, search, filters and paging in the client or on the server, status and tag cells, row actions, bulk selection, loading skeletons and empty states.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog with a header, a scrolling body and actions, five sizes, a hero icon, dismissal control and a full-screen layout for phones.

items.name: disclosure
items.title: Disclosure
items.description: An expandable section with a heading trigger and an animated panel, plus an Accordion that groups several as plain, surface or separated lists.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: A 1px separator, horizontal or vertical, subtle or strong, full width or inset, with an optional label such as a localised “or”.

items.name: ds-provider
items.title: DSProvider
items.description: Supplies locale, client-side routing, message overrides, icons and the motion preference to every component.

items.name: dynamic-color
items.title: Dynamic colour
items.description: Build the whole colour scheme at runtime from a brand colour, a user's choice or a photo, for one card or the whole page, in light, dark and every contrast level.

items.name: dynamic-island
items.title: Dynamic Island
items.description: A pill that holds one live activity and grows into a card on one spring, with the compact and expanded faces swapping through a blurred cross-fade, a nudge when the activity changes, separate buttons for its controls and announcements for discrete events.

items.name: dynamic-theme
items.title: Dynamic theme
items.description: Applies a scheme generated from a seed colour to a subtree or to the whole page, following light, dark and contrast, with a cached boot script for user-chosen themes and an animated theme switch.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Centred placeholder for empty tables, lists and pages, with an icon or illustration, a heading, a description and up to two actions, in three sizes.

items.name: fab
items.title: FAB
items.description: Floating action button as a raised pill in two tones and two sizes, with an extended form that shrinks on scroll and a menu for two to six related actions.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: The shared contract every input follows, with a label, description, error, character counter and outline or soft controls in three sizes.

items.name: file-dropzone
items.title: File dropzone
items.description: A filled drop box that grows toward a file held over it, opens the file picker on click or Enter, takes paste, refuses files by type, size or count with a shake and a red line, and gulps the files it accepts.

items.name: file-list
items.title: File list
items.description: Rows of files, each with a page icon whose coloured extension label sticks out of it, the name truncated in the middle, the size, a rolling percentage over a thin bar while it uploads, a check when it is done, and retry, cancel and remove actions.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File upload
items.description: A file dropzone and a file list wired to your upload function, with progress, concurrency, cancel through an AbortSignal, retry, announcements, and a single-file layout whose box closes around the one file it holds.

items.name: files
items.title: File helpers
items.description: Checks and formatting for picked and dropped files: type, size and count validation, locale-aware sizes, file kinds and extensions.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: Circular icon-only button in four variants, three tones and four sizes, with a toggle twin, a link twin and automatic pending state for async actions.

items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.description: The glyphs components draw themselves, and how to replace them.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard key hints, one key or a shortcut combination that shows ⌘ on Apple platforms and Ctrl elsewhere, with full key names for screen readers.

items.name: labels
items.title: Labels
items.description: The labels contract: English defaults that components write on their own, replaced per component or app-wide, with templates that take a string or a function for plurals.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line Chart
items.description: One or several lines with monotone, linear or step curves, gaps for missing values, dashed comparison series and a crosshair that carries the tooltip.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Text link in an inline and a standalone style and three tones, with an optional forward arrow, external links that announce the new tab, router navigation and a disabled state.

items.name: list-box
items.title: List box
items.description: Selectable list with sections, icons or avatars, descriptions, a check mark for selected rows, two densities and load-more.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A menu that opens from a button or a right click, with icons, descriptions, platform-aware shortcuts, sections, selection, submenus and links.

items.name: motion
items.title: Motion tokens
items.description: Springs for gestures, the fluid and out-quad easings and durations, and the motion preference types.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number field
items.description: Number input with minus and plus, stacked chevrons or a compact quantity slab, locale-aware formats and digits that roll like an odometer.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Numbered page navigation with ellipses, a sliding current-page indicator, and a compact form with icon arrows when its container is narrow.

items.name: password-field
items.title: Password field
items.description: Password input with a reveal toggle, a Caps Lock warning, autofill hints and an optional strength meter and requirements checklist.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger, with placement, an optional arrow, motion that grows from the trigger, and a dialog part with a title, a close button and two paddings.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Linear and circular progress indicators, determinate or indeterminate, in six tones and three sizes, with value labels formatted for the locale.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Radio group with per-option descriptions, vertical or horizontal layout and a card variant for option pickers.

items.name: rolling-number
items.title: Rolling number
items.description: A formatted number whose digits roll like an odometer, each column counting forward through its carry, with the plain value read to screen readers.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search field
items.description: Search input with a clear button, submit on Enter, a pending spinner, a focus shortcut and a soft variant for header search bars.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Pill-shaped segmented control for one or several choices, with a raised selection that slides between segments.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Pick one or several options from a list, with icons and avatars, sections, chips or a count, and async loading.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Panel that slides in from any edge or floats detached, with sizes per side, header, body and footer parts, and bottom sheets that drag to dismiss, rest at snap points or stay open beside the page.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholders in text, block and circle shapes that follow the line height, shimmer or pulse, and can wrap real content until it has loaded.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Thin-rail slider with one value or a range, stops, labelled marks, a centred fill, a value bubble and vertical orientation.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A word-sized line or area for stat tiles and table cells, named and described by its trend, with an end dot at the latest value.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A small decorative spinner in four sizes that follows the current text colour, for pending buttons, chips and inline status text.

items.name: status-tag
items.title: Status Tag
items.description: Status labels driven by a key, sixteen built-in states with a tone and a dot each, extended with the app's own keys, labels and tones, plus a StatusDot for lists.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Switch with a sliding pill thumb, two sizes, optional thumb icons, descriptions and a row layout for settings pages.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Styled React Aria table parts with a tinted header, sortable columns, checkbox selection, two densities, a sticky header and row header, and a load-more row.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Underline and pill tabs with a sliding indicator, icons, badges, scroll buttons for long lists and a vertical layout.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: Compact status labels in six tones and three variants, with an optional dot or icon, plus a TagGroup for removable or selectable tags.

items.name: text-area
items.title: Text area
items.description: Multi-line input on the shared Field contract that grows with its content between a minimum and maximum number of rows, with a character counter.

items.name: text-field
items.title: Text field
items.description: Single-line input on the shared Field contract, with start and end adornments, a clear button, a character counter and native types for email, URL and phone.

items.name: theme-scope
items.title: Theme scope
items.description: Carries the nearest dynamic theme scope to overlays that portal out of it, so popovers, menus and dialogs keep the scheme of the element that opened them.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Colour roles, layers, solid and soft fills, radius families, shadows, motion keyframes and the focus-ring utilities, generated from one seed colour.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toasts with a global toast() API, five tones, an action, promise and in-place updates, six logical placements and a stack that fans out on hover or focus.

items.name: toggle-button
items.title: Toggle Button
items.description: Pill button that stays on or off, in soft and ghost variants, plus a group for single or multiple selection.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Dark plain tooltips and light rich tooltips that open on hover and keyboard focus, with keyboard shortcut hints, a shared group for toolbars and an interactive rich variant.

items.name: use-controllable-state
items.title: useControllableState
items.description: State that works controlled through value and onChange, or uncontrolled from a default.

items.name: use-image-seed
items.title: useImageSeed
items.description: Ranks seed colours from an image URL, file or element, for themes that follow a photo, cover or avatar.

items.name: use-local-storage-state
items.title: useLocalStorageState
items.description: State kept in localStorage, synchronised across components and tabs, with a server value for static rendering.

items.name: use-media-query
items.title: useMediaQuery
items.description: Subscribes to a CSS media query, with a server value for static rendering.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utilities
items.description: cn() and a tv() preconfigured to merge the radius families and easings the theme adds.
